hint: What Persona sent in your name, and why it was allowed
intro: What Persona sent in your name through your connectors, newest first. Select a row for the full text.
empty_recorded: Recorded: what Persona sends in your name through a connector (mail, GitHub comments, Lark writes), and sends an extension reports itself.
empty_not_recorded: Not recorded: what you send yourself in the app, writes that were refused, declined or failed, and anything lark-cli writes.
empty_days: Records are kept for 90 days by default.
no_database: This hub runs without a database, so what was sent as you isn't recorded.
forbidden: Only a device with full access can read this list. Open Persona on one of your own devices that has it.
unsupported: This hub's version doesn't record what was sent as you yet. Update the hub and come back.
by_card: Confirmed by you on a card
detail_always: You chose “Always allow” for this in the chat, so no card was shown.
detail_card: You were asked on a confirmation card and allowed it.
detail_assistant: The assistant answered the card on your behalf.
detail_auto: The extension sent it on its own: no rule and no card.
detail_auto_setting: The extension sent it on its own, allowed by its setting {setting}: no rule and no card.
text_cut: The text is cut at {count} characters here. The message itself may be longer.
rules_footer: These rules allow only comments or messages in the named destination. Other actions still ask. Lark gates can take a minute to update; an offline node may keep an old rule until it reconnects.
rule_exists: Allowed for this chat. Manage or revoke the rule in Chat approval rules.
rule_row_unsupported: This hub did not provide rule eligibility for this record. Update the hub to add a chat rule.
rule_confirm_github: Allow future GitHub comments through {connector} in {chat} without asking each time?
rule_confirm_lark: Allow future messages through {connector} in {chat} without asking each time?
rule_scope: Only this destination is covered. Reviews, replies and other actions still ask; existing stricter approval settings still apply. You can revoke this rule below.
rule_revoke_effect: Revoke the rule for {connector} · {chat}? Future writes will follow the usual approval settings again.
rule_store_failed: This rule is temporarily off, but saving its removal failed. It may return after the hub restarts. Retry revoke to finish removing it.
rule_forbidden: This device cannot perform this rule action. Use one of your own devices with full access.
rule_no_database: This hub has no database to keep chat rules. Try again after a database is available.
rule_unsupported: This hub version does not support this chat rule action. Update the hub and retry.
rule_pruned: This sent record is no longer available. Choose a newer record for the same destination.
rule_gone: The hub could not find this rule. Refresh the list to check its current state.
rule_full: The chat rule limit has been reached. Revoke an existing rule before adding another.
rule_error: The hub could not confirm this change. Refresh to check the current state, then retry if needed.
rule_verify: The request completed, but the latest state could not be read. Refresh to verify the change.
rule_reason_recorded: This send was reported by an extension and cannot create a chat rule.
rule_reason_mail: Mail needs confirmation for each send and cannot create a chat rule.
rule_reason_review: Reviews still need confirmation. Choose a comment to allow one issue or pull request.
rule_reason_reply: Replies still need confirmation. Choose a message sent directly to the conversation.
rule_reason_route: This action cannot be allowed by a chat rule.
rule_reason_target: This record does not identify one destination for a chat rule.
rule_reason_command: This record cannot identify a supported chat gate. Choose a newer send from an updated node.
rule_reason_unknown: This connector does not offer a rule for this chat.
rule_read_error: Chat rules could not be loaded. Check the connection and refresh to retry.
recall_confirm: Take back this message through {connector}? It is removed for everyone who can see it, and this can't be undone.
recall_forbidden: Only one of your own devices with full access can recall a message.
recall_unsupported: This hub's version can't recall messages. Update the hub and try again.
recall_not_found: This record is no longer on the hub.
recall_too_old: This message is too old to recall now.
recall_unavailable: The connector is off, signed out or offline. Turn it on or sign in, then try again.
recall_no_database: This hub runs without a database, so it can't recall messages.
recall_unknown: It isn't known whether the message was removed. Try again to check.
